channel.title: David Uhden Collado's Blog
channel.description: Latest articles and updates from David Uhden Collado's blog.

item.title: Create an OpenBSD Installation Image with a FAT32 ESP and Firmware
item.description: Create a custom OpenBSD amd64 installation image with a 260 MiB FAT32 ESP, additional FFS space, and optional firmware without rebuilding the base system.

item.title: The GPL: Paradoxes in Free Software
item.description: The GPL was meant to protect software freedom, but its reciprocal restrictions can limit collaboration and create tension between copyleft and permissive models.

item.title: GNU FSDG and RYF: Freedom, Firmware, and Hardware Reality
OpenBSD: Security Through Simplicity and System Design
item.description: OpenBSD treats security as a system property through minimal defaults, proactive auditing, layered mitigations, and focused base-system implementations.

item.title: Reinventing Operating Systems: Lessons from OpenBSD and Beyond
item.description: Enterprise operating systems preserve compatibility contracts; OpenBSD and Apple accept deliberate breaks when old interfaces obstruct security, simplicity, or architectural change.

item.title: Rethinking the UNIX Philosophy: Beyond Small Programs
item.description: UNIX is more than tiny tools and pipes; its real power lies in composability and thoughtful integration, not in a simplistic blueprint for microservices.
